title: CI coverage counts a test as covered only when its run step can fail the job
why: CiCoverage counts a test as covered when its only run step has continue-on-error: true or if: false, so its red blocks nothing (lane test-file-in-ci, 07:32 CST Nov 8).
note: Follow-up PR with Merge after: #1686. Debt ci-coverage-ungated-run points its Fix line at that PR. Doing in lane test-file-in-ci at the coordinator's ask (07:32 CST Nov 8). Title by triage.
